anyOf.description: Explicit native content version. Omit to derive a version from the inspected artifact.

version.description: Explicit native content version. Omit to derive a version from the inspected artifact.

anyOf.description: Preserve a vendor PKG, select items in an existing DMG, or publish a script-only item. PKG is inferred only from a .pkg payload.

installer_type.description: Preserve a vendor PKG, select items in an existing DMG, or publish a script-only item. PKG is inferred only from a .pkg payload.

anyOf.description: Native Munki metadata. Omitted fields remain unmanaged; explicit lists own the whole collection.

pkginfo.description: Native Munki metadata. Omitted fields remain unmanaged; explicit lists own the whole collection.

installer.description: Input to publish: source, prepared, artifacts/name or stepName/outputName. Omit to use the prepared source payload.

additionalProperties.description: Input to publish: source, prepared, artifacts/name or stepName/outputName. Omit to use the prepared source payload.

inputs.description: Additional named immutable inputs supplied to the destination operation, using the same artifact reference syntax.

trusted.description: Explicit consent to execute this plugin. Checksums prove binary identity, not publisher trust.

image.description: OCI registry reference with a tag or digest, for example ghcr.io/example/inventory:v1.0.0.

imports.description: Project-relative Software document paths or globs, such as software/**/*.yaml. Every pattern must match.

components.description: Reusable software defaults. Maps merge recursively; lists and null replace inherited values.

destinations.description: Named connections, separate from each Software document's native destination metadata.

plugins.description: Explicitly trusted OCI plugin images, locked by release index digest.

extends.description: Local component name. Maps merge recursively; lists and null replace inherited values.

source.description: Optional acquisition input. Omit when operations and destinations need no acquired artifact. Its lock fingerprint excludes preparation and destination metadata.

platform.description: Target software platform, independent of the runner operating system.

arch.description: Target architecture. Universal is an explicit vendor artifact containing multiple architectures.

select.description: Exact relative payload path within an archive. Required when several plausible payloads exist.

verification.description: Required verification subject and scope. Unsupported required checks block publication.

subjects.description: Named selections of observed subjects for explicit fact references. Referenced selectors must match exactly one subject in the consumer input; declarations do not change delivery or detection.

artifacts.description: Named reproducible packages derived from the prepared source. Refer to a package as artifacts/name.

steps.description: Sequential operation invocations with named inputs and outputs. A step may consume only original inputs, declared artifacts or outputs of preceding steps.

anyOf.description: Native metadata and typed fact references, validated by the selected operation.

destinations.description: Map named destinations to native writable metadata. Explicit values may reference named subject facts with {$fact: subject_name.app.version}; references retain their native type and are validated before publication.

type.description: Source provider. Unknown values are rejected.

include.description: Local files and glob patterns relative to this Software document. Matched bytes, modes and symlinks determine content identity.

url.description: Stable HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials or expiring query parameters.

match.description: HTTP download-page regular expression matching one distinct complete artifact URL. HTML entities are decoded before matching. The resolved URL is pinned in the source lock.

path.description: Filesystem path. Source paths must stay within the Stemma project.

release.description: GitHub release tag or latest. New releases are resolved only during explicit updates or permitted missing lock resolution.

asset.description: Exact GitHub release asset filename, avoiding ambiguous glob matches.

filename.description: Retained artifact basename. Never a workspace or cache path.

sha256.description: Optional independently obtained SHA-256 requirement. Explicit refresh does not bypass this requirement.

token.description: Bearer token. Use ${VAR} to supply it from the environment. Excluded from source locks and fingerprints.

name.description: Unique step name used by later input references. The names source, prepared and artifacts are reserved.

operation.description: Registered built-in or external operation name. Its descriptor defines accepted inputs, outputs and configuration.

inputs.description: Map operation input names to source, prepared, artifacts/name or priorStep/outputName. Inputs may be files or trees according to the operation contract.

config.description: Operation configuration validated against its registered contract.

kind.description: Observed subject kind: app, package or msi.

path.description: Exact path within the inspected artifact.

installed_path.description: Observed absolute installation path, when the installer declares one.

bundle_id.description: Application bundle identifier, combined with any supplied path selectors.

subject.description: Verify source, prepared, artifacts/name or stepName/outputName explicitly. Omitted or payload verifies each destination's primary artifact. A container signature does not verify an inner application.

integrity.description: Require all supported signed byte and hash checks for the selected subject.

signature.description: Require a cryptographically valid signature, separately from signer trust.

resources.description: Require sealed application resources. Unsupported nested-code layouts fail closed.

identity.description: Require authenticated signer identity using an implemented trust policy.

certificate_sha256.description: Exact SHA-256 pin of the authenticated PKG or supported Mach-O signer DER certificate. This does not claim CA trust or revocation assessment.

platform.description: Require native OS policy assessment. Unsupported on portable verifier implementations.

title: Stemma documents
description: One Project document at the root; imported family files contain Software documents separated by ---. String values under spec support whole-value ${VAR} environment placeholders. Omitted metadata fields remain unmanaged; null clears only supported fields.
